entries.title: Update Infinitary on your other computers and phone
entries.body: This version changes how your devices work together. A computer that runs work for you takes no new work until it runs this version too, and you can update it from Devices. A computer that controls your first mate can look but not change anything until it is updated. Update Infinitary on your phone too.
entries.noPicture: This changes connection compatibility and saved-conversation recovery, not the layout or words of a screen.
